seo__search_description: Free, confidential gambling counselling at Oakdene House, provided by Catholic Care. By appointment. Fairfield, Western Sydney.
hero__intro: Free, confidential one-on-one counselling for people affected by gambling.
overview__text: Oakdene offers free, confidential one-on-one gambling counselling delivered by our team. Our counsellors are specially trained and experienced in addiction counselling, supporting people affected by gambling and helping them work through their challenges with dignity and respect.
overview__text_2: Counselling is delivered by appointment on a one-to-one basis. All conversations are confidential and non-judgmental.
overview__text_10: If you need to talk right now, the Gambling Help Line is free and available 24 hours a day.
what_we_address__intro: Gambling can affect every part of a person's life. Our counsellors work with you across all of it.
what_we_address__text: Debt, loss of income, and financial instability are common consequences. Counselling helps you understand your options and plan ahead. Our [Financial Counselling](/services/financial-counselling/) service can also help with gambling-related financial harm, debt, and money stress.
what_we_address__text_2: Gambling can strain family and personal relationships. We support honest conversations and rebuilding trust.
what_we_address__text_3: Shame, anxiety and depression often accompany problem gambling. Counselling provides a space to process these experiences.
what_we_address__text_4: We help you identify goals, build strategies and develop a personalised path forward.
cta__subheading: You do not have to figure this out alone. Reach out and we will arrange an appointment.
